ns2:section.sectionText: This section will open to all students in the College of Business on Monday, April 21, 2014 and to business minors on Monday, April 28, 2014 at approximately 9:00 a.m. This section will open to Informatics Minor and Industrial & Enterprise Systems Engineering students on Monday, May 5, 2014 at approximately 9:00 a.m. There are currently 5 reserved seats for College of Business international exchange students; any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, August 29, 2014 at approximately 9:00 a.m. This is an elective course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor admitted prior to January 2013.
